High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Prakash Padia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceeding of Case Crime No.0193 of 2022 (State vs. Mohd. Naeem and others) under Sections- 498A, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act Police Station Babupurwa District Kanpur.

entities.text: Case Crime No.0193 of 2022 (State vs. Mohd. Naeem and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: D.P. Act Police Station Babupurwa District Kanpur
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have reconciled their differences and a compromise have entered between them which has been reduced in writing.
Copy of the same is annexed as Annexure No.(2) to the present application.

It is further submitted that a copy of the Mohd. Mueen And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7588432/
1 compromise has already been filed by the parties before the court below.

entities.text: Mohd. Mueen And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned AGA appearing for the opposite party no. 1 does not dispute the correctness of the aforesaid submission made by learned counsel for the applicants.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, direction is issued to the court below to fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next four weeks.
6. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
7. For a period of two months or till the final order passed on the compromise application by the court below whichever is earlier, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants.
8. In case, the applicants are still aggrieved or if no action is taken, it will be open for the applicants to approach this Court afresh.

Order Date :- 11.8.2023 S.K.
